_notes: Gate A. Lab probes that may differ from stock of the same version on the same computer, each with the reason. compare: only these sub-paths of the value must equal stock (robust sub-signals of hashed probes). match: our value (as JSON) must match this regex. engines: limits the entry to chromium or firefox. Keep this list short: a difference that is not caused by a per-profile seed is a tell to fix, not an entry.

antibot-re/canvas-main-vs-worker.reason: Per-profile canvas noise changes the shape and text hashes; main thread and worker must still agree.

antidetect-tells/canvas-main-worker-sand.reason: Per-profile canvas noise changes the hash; main, worker and sandboxed iframe must still agree.

creepjs/cross-realm-render-and-screen-eq.reason: Per-profile canvas noise changes the render hash; all realms must still agree and the screen must not differ between them.

creepjs/emoji-glyph-metrics-vs-os.reason: Per-profile canvas noise changes the emoji pixel hash; the glyph metrics themselves must equal stock.
